name: Lanternfly
description: a little moth-like bug of the Rune Bridges with four papery pale wings and a glowing cyan lantern for an abdomen, thin legs, big dark eyes

poses.stand: flying, wings spread, the lantern abdomen glowing
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: flutters in place, the lantern glowing

move.action: flutters forward to the right, staying in the same spot in the frame

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
